title.narrative: Consolidando el fortalecimiento político de la Agroecología desde el MAELA

description.narrative: This project willl strengthen MAELA, with the aspiration of consolidating the functioning of the continental coordination structures of the four regions and national structures in 18 countries, as well as the formation of the working groups of each of the strategic axes of MAELA for the year 2026. Support will be maintained for participation in international advocacy spaces in Agroecology before FAO, the United Nations (UN), the International Planning Committee for Food Sovereignty (IPC), the UN Civil Society Mechanism (CSM), and other international alliances in favor of Agroecology, the protagonism of women and youth, the mitigation of climate change, the defense of the territories and human rights of indigenous and Afro-descendant peasant communities that promote agroecology in Latin America and the Caribbean.
